**Analysis:** The persistent entity types are defined in the `store` package (the data-access/data layer for this repo, `github.com/usememos/memos`), e.g. `User` (`store/user.go`), `Memo` (`store/memo.go`), `Attachment` (`store/attachment.go`), `Reaction` (`store/reaction.go`), `Inbox` (`store/inbox.go`), `UserSetting` (`store/user_setting.go`), `MemoShare` (`store/memo_share.go`), `MemoRelation` (`store/memo_relation.go`), `UserIdentity` (`store/user_identity.go`), `IdentityProvider` (`store/idp.go`), `InstanceSetting` (`store/instance_setting.go`).

Searching for `store.<Type>` usages outside the `store` package and counting distinct importing packages (directories):

- `store.User` is referenced in 7 packages: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go`, `server/auth/context.go`), `server/notification` (`server/notification/email.go`), `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/api/v1` (many files, e.g. `server/router/api/v1/user_service.go`, `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go`), `server/router/api/v1/test`.
- `store.Memo` is referenced in 6 packages: `server/notification`, `server/runner/memopayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`), `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/api/v1` (e.g. `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, `memo_service_converter.go`), `server/router/api/v1/test`.

Other types trail well behind: `store.Attachment` (~4 packages: `server/router/api/v1`, `.../test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`), `store.Inbox`/`store.MemoShare`/`store.MemoRelation` (~3 packages each), `store.UserIdentity`/`store.Reaction` (~2 packages each).

**Answer:**
1st: `User` (`store/user.go`) — referenced from ~7 packages outside `store` (`server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`)
2nd: `Memo` (`store/memo.go`) — referenced from ~6 packages outside `store` (`server/notification`, `server/runner/memopayload`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`)
